title: Weight Clustering Reveals the Importance of Relative Rank in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.17917v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) contain billions of parameters, but many exact weight values are not essential. We apply scalar $K$-means clustering to pretrained models, replacing each weight matrix with only 16--64 shared values. For Llama~3.1-8B-Instruct and SmolLM2-135M, this preserves strong accuracy without retraining, providing a simple way to compress LLMs on disk. Fine-tuning only the cluster centroids further recovers 30--40\% of the remaining accuracy loss. Using clustering as an analysis tool, we then keep the cluster assignments fixed and perturb only the shared values, to study which of their properties matter most. We find that preserving their \emph{relative rank} (which connections are stronger or weaker than others) is more important than preserving their exact magnitudes. translated_title: 权重聚类揭示大语言模型中相对排序的重要性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型包含数十亿参数，但许多精确的权重值并非必需。我们对预训练模型应用标量 K 均值聚类，仅用 16-64 个共享值替换每个权重矩阵。对于 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct 和 SmolLM2-135M，该方法在无需重新训练的情况下保持了较高的准确率，为在磁盘上压缩大语言模型提供了一种简单途径。仅对聚类中心进行微调，可进一步恢复 30-40% 的剩余精度损失。随后，我们将聚类作为分析工具，固定聚类分配，仅扰动共享值，以研究其哪些性质最为关键。我们发现，保持这些值的相对排序（即哪些连接比其他连接更强或更弱）比保持它们的精确数值更为重要。破坏这种排序会显著增加困惑度，而改变数值但保持排序在许多中间层几乎不造成损失。
tldr: 利用标量 K 均值聚类将大语言模型权重压缩为 16-64 个共享值并可在不重训的情况下保持性能，并通过扰动实验揭示保持权重间的相对排序比保持精确数值更重要。
en_tdlr: Scalar K-means clustering compresses LLM weights to only 16-64 shared values without retraining, revealing that preserving the relative rank of weight values matters more than preserving their exact magnitudes.
